1/ Cash Flow Brief, Nov 7 ☀️

US strikes on Iran and reports of tankers hitting mines in Hormuz could push oil and fuel prices up, while crypto law stalls after the midterms.

What happened, why it matters, and what could happen next 🧵

2/ Trump said US forces carried out "minor strikes" on Iranian air defence. Iranian media reported missile strikes on Qeshm island. Why it matters: Hormuz is key oil route; energy risk can lift fuel costs. Next: If strikes continue, oil may swing.

3/ Economy: No data was released overnight. GM flagged a $2B inflation hit. CFTC data shows net oil positions rose to 80.3K from 74.3K.

Why it matters: Rising costs can reach car and fuel prices.

Next: If oil keeps rising, then pump prices could follow.

4/ Thu: Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 12.3%, worst since March 2020. Nasdaq 100 dropped 6.3%. Why: index funds hold these names, so your 401(k) can feel it. Next: If AI fears persist, chip stocks may stay under pressure. Nvidia reports Nov 17.

5/ Crypto: Bitcoin near $76,100; Fear & Greed Index at 25 (Extreme Fear). CLARITY Act failed Senate vote 49-50 in September. Why: crypto rules may restart in January. Next: Warren may chair Senate Banking; then probes are possible. Not financial advice.

1/ Cash Flow Brief: Evening, Nov 7 🌙

Iran tensions around the Strait of Hormuz and the Democratic midterm sweep could move oil prices and policy, while stock markets stay closed for the weekend.

What happened today and what to watch Sunday 🧵

2/ Politics: Trump said Friday US forces made minor strikes on Iranian air defenses (Al Jazeera). Hormuz is a key oil route, so energy risk can lift fuel costs. Tomorrow: Watch if Iran strikes continue; if so, oil could swing when markets reopen.

3/ Economy: Democrats seek to undo Trump's economic policy and repeal tariffs (Modern Ghana). Tariff changes can shift what imported goods cost you. Tomorrow: Watch if Congress moves on tariffs; no hearings with dates were found.

4/ Stocks: SpaceX and Tesla shares fell premarket after Democrats swept the midterms (WSJ). If you hold them in a 401(k) or index fund, swings may hit at reopening. Tomorrow: Cisco leads 9 big earnings reports this week.

5/ Crypto: Bitcoin was at 75,745.83 and Ether at 2,236.16 (Yahoo, may be delayed). BlackRock ETF clients sold $403M of Bitcoin (Cryptonews.net). ETF outflows may signal cautious demand. Watch if outflows continue Monday. Not financial advice.
